question: Can a scalar zero-label test-time shift inferred from frozen REM-Net event-waveform self-consistency recover Fold-2 continuous PCC without test ECG adaptation labels?
adaptation_input: the first K=2 held-out-subject WSST windows and frozen model outputs only
adapted_parameter: one scalar circular Fourier shift tau_sub initialized at zero; all REM-Net weights frozen
loss: event-morphology derivative-energy cosine loss + 0.5 times waveform autocorrelation prominence
evaluation: freeze tau, exclude the first K adaptation windows, then load ECG solely to report per-window mean PCC@0 on the remaining Fold-2 windows
prohibitions: no ECG tensor may be constructed or loaded before tau is frozen
no GT-derived lag, affine map, checkpoint, stopping rule, or hyperparameter selection
pilot cannot support a manuscript claim or authorize scaling
falsification_note: circular autocorrelation is shift invariant and the event/waveform heads may share an offset; a near-zero tau or no PCC gain falsifies this self-calibration mechanism
